experiment.name: Curriculum-trained Multi-hop Trajectory and Attention Pilot
experiment.research_object: Six-layer Transformer trained from balanced one-hop retrieval through three-hop pointer composition

hypotheses.primary: In a successfully learned multi-hop computation, ordered layer-state history improves future-flip prediction beyond current, dimension-matched, shuffled, and sample-mismatched controls.
hypotheses.attention: Ordered per-head attention-summary history improves prediction beyond the current state plus current attention and matched attention-history controls.
hypotheses.secondary: Ordered state and attention histories improve prediction of future reduction in negative log-likelihood under their respective controls.
hypotheses.null: Neither historical family adds stable predictive information after current state and current attention are available.

interpretation_boundary: Probe improvements establish incremental decodability under the stated controls; they do not by themselves establish causal use or metacognition.
